description: The shared presets of yuanying/renovate-config hold the two-day wait, the ubuntu exception and the github-actions group. platform-automerge turns on GitHub's auto-merge for every update when its pull request is opened, and the ruleset on main holds it until a code owner in .github/CODEOWNERS approves it and CI passes. CI runs on every pull request, with no paths filter, so every branch Renovate opens is tested before it is merged. What is merged this way reaches a release on its own through the weekly release
